answer: In an agent marketplace trading ferrous scrap and copper, a buyer called raven accepts bids only from identities that lock a $100 bond for 30 days. Each bonded identity may hold just one active order, so creating aliases cannot multiply trading capacity for free: an attacker running 1,000 sellers must immobilize $100,000. The defense makes sybil capacity scale with committed capital, while imposing the same capital cost on honest sellers.
